quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a last-mile delivery optimisation platform for urban courier networks handling thousands of daily drops.
quests.correctAnswer: Thousands of daily drops are quietly reordered into the fastest possible route each morning, cutting both delivery time and fuel cost.
quests.hint: Start with the daily scale plus the dual saving.
quests.explanation: Pairing a time saving with a cost saving gives an operations pitch two separate, concrete reasons to matter.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that turns weekly chores into a friendly points competition between siblings.
quests.correctAnswer: Chores quietly become a points competition between siblings, so the vacuuming gets done because someone wants to win, not because they were told to.
quests.hint: Begin with motivation through competition, not obligation.
quests.explanation: Turning obligation into competition is a clever behavioural shift that gets a chore done without a single argument.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cold chain monitoring platform ensuring vaccines stay within a safe temperature range from factory to clinic.
quests.correctAnswer: Temperature is tracked at every step from factory to clinic, so a vaccine that arrives has actually stayed safe to use.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the full journey being tracked, not just storage.
quests.explanation: Tracking the entire journey, not just one point, is what actually guarantees a medicine's safety on arrival.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a returns management platform that cuts the cost of reverse logistics for online clothing retailers.
quests.correctAnswer: A returned item is resold or restocked within days instead of sitting in a warehouse for weeks, quietly recovering lost margin.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on speed of recovery, not just returns handling.
quests.explanation: Speed of recovery is the specific detail that turns an ordinary returns process into a genuine cost saving.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription app that helps adults learn to cook their own culture's traditional dishes from a relative's guidance.
quests.correctAnswer: A grandparent's recipe becomes a simple, filmed lesson, so a dish only ever cooked by memory finally gets passed on properly.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in preserving something that could otherwise be lost.
quests.explanation: Preventing the quiet loss of a family recipe gives an ordinary cooking app real, lasting emotional value.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a gig-work marketplace connecting enterprises with on-demand specialists for short, well-defined projects.
quests.correctAnswer: A business gets exactly the specialist it needs for six weeks, without the cost or commitment of a permanent hire.
quests.hint: Lead with the exact-fit, temporary nature of the match.
quests.explanation: Solving a temporary need without a permanent cost is precisely what makes specialist gig work attractive to a business.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a skills-based hiring platform that replaces degree requirements with verified, practical competency tests.
quests.correctAnswer: Candidates prove what they can actually do, not just what degree they hold, opening roles to people the usual filters quietly excluded.
quests.hint: Open with what candidates can prove, not their credentials.
quests.explanation: Proof of ability, rather than a credential, opens genuinely good roles to people who were being filtered out unfairly.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood app connecting people who want to learn an instrument with local hobbyist teachers nearby.
quests.correctAnswer: A hobbyist down the street teaches guitar on Saturday mornings, for a fraction of what a formal music school would charge.
quests.hint: Start with the local, affordable, informal alternative.
quests.explanation: An affordable, informal local option removes the two biggest barriers - cost and intimidation - that stop most adults from starting.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a continuous learning platform that delivers one short, relevant lesson to employees every working day.
quests.correctAnswer: One short, genuinely relevant lesson lands each morning, so learning becomes a daily five-minute habit instead of an annual training day nobody remembers.
quests.hint: Contrast a daily habit with an annual training day.
quests.explanation: Contrasting a daily habit with a forgettable annual event shows exactly why small, frequent learning tends to actually work.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a knowledge-management platform that captures an expert employee's know-how before they retire or leave.
quests.correctAnswer: An expert's know-how is captured in their own words before they walk out the door, so the next hire isn't starting from zero.
quests.hint: Begin with what's lost when someone leaves, not the software itself.
quests.explanation: Naming what's actually lost when an expert leaves makes a knowledge tool feel urgent, not just nice to have.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that helps a household agree on a fair, realistic pocket-money system for kids of different ages.
quests.correctAnswer: Pocket money scales fairly by age and by chores done, so the youngest stops asking why their sibling gets more for less.
quests.hint: Name the sibling comparison this settles.
quests.explanation: Settling a specific sibling comparison is a small but very real source of household peace.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a factory energy management system that cuts power consumption without slowing down production.
quests.correctAnswer: Energy use drops measurably across the factory floor, while the production line itself never has to slow down to make it happen.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the saving happening without any trade-off.
quests.explanation: Removing the usual trade-off between saving energy and staying productive is what makes plant managers actually listen.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an executive coaching platform matching leaders with coaches based on shared goals and working style.
quests.correctAnswer: A leader is matched with a coach who fits both their goals and how they actually work, not just whoever happened to be available.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on fit, not just coach availability.
quests.explanation: Matching by genuine fit, not convenience, is what makes an executive actually stick with a coaching relationship.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a shopping app that finds a matching replacement part for a broken appliance instead of a whole new one.
quests.correctAnswer: Find the exact part your appliance needs, and fix it for a fraction of what a full replacement would have cost.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in the small fix versus a full replacement.
quests.explanation: Contrasting a small fix with an expensive full replacement makes repair feel like the obviously smarter choice.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workforce planning tool that models a company's future skill needs against its current team's capability.
quests.correctAnswer: It maps exactly where tomorrow's skill gaps will appear, giving a company time to train or hire before the gap actually costs them.
quests.hint: Lead with acting before the gap becomes a real cost.
quests.explanation: Acting before a gap becomes urgent is a far cheaper, calmer position than scrambling to fill it later.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a boardroom effectiveness platform that measures the quality of a company's governance objectively.
quests.correctAnswer: Governance quality is measured with real evidence instead of a boardroom's own impression of how well meetings are actually run.
quests.hint: Contrast objective measurement with self-reported impressions.
quests.explanation: Objective measurement is more persuasive to a board than any amount of self-reported confidence.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that helps a family document a grandparent's life story through simple guided conversations.
quests.correctAnswer: A few guided questions each week slowly turn a grandparent's memories into a story the whole family will have forever.
quests.hint: Open with what's preserved forever, not the conversation format.
quests.explanation: Framing the product around what's preserved forever gives simple guided questions real, lasting weight.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an employee financial wellbeing platform offering early access to earned wages plus basic financial coaching.
quests.correctAnswer: Employees can access wages they've already earned before payday, alongside simple coaching that helps that gap close for good over time.
quests.hint: Start with the immediate relief plus the longer-term fix.
quests.explanation: Pairing immediate relief with a longer-term fix shows genuine care, not just a short-term financial product.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a preventive workplace health programme that targets chronic disease risk across an entire employee population.
quests.correctAnswer: Risk factors are caught early across the whole workforce, preventing a costly health crisis instead of just responding once it's already happened.
quests.hint: Begin with prevention across the group, not individual treatment.
quests.explanation: Prevention across a whole population is a genuinely different, and more valuable, promise than treating illness after the fact.

quests.prompt: Pitch a neighbourhood app that organises a fair, rotating car-share for parents doing the weekly supermarket run.
quests.correctAnswer: One parent drives the whole street to the supermarket this week, and it's someone else's turn next - petrol and time, finally shared fairly.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in fairness in the rotation, not just car-sharing.
quests.explanation: Fairness in the rotation is what actually gets busy parents to commit to a shared weekly errand.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a sleep wellness programme designed specifically for the unique challenges faced by shift workers.

quests.explanation: Naming the mismatch between ordinary advice and shift work is exactly why this programme feels made for its audience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a brand sentiment monitoring platform tracking how a company is discussed across social media in many languages.

quests.explanation: Catching a problem while it's still small is worth far more to a brand than a late, large-scale response.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that helps parents plan and budget a child's birthday party without last-minute overspending.
quests.correctAnswer: Set a budget once, and it keeps every decision - cake, decorations, entertainment - inside it, so the final bill never comes as a surprise.
quests.hint: Lead with avoiding the surprise bill, not the planning itself.
quests.explanation: Avoiding a surprise bill is a very specific, very common parental worry worth naming directly.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a supplier diversity platform helping large companies track and grow spending with minority-owned businesses.
quests.correctAnswer: Spending with minority-owned suppliers is tracked clearly and grown deliberately, turning a stated company value into a number leadership can actually see.
quests.hint: Open with turning a value into a measurable number.
quests.explanation: Turning a stated value into a visible number is what actually holds a company accountable to it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an inclusive recruitment training platform that measurably reduces bias in hiring managers' decisions.
quests.correctAnswer: Hiring managers practise real scenarios and get honest feedback, measurably reducing bias instead of just sitting through a once-a-year slideshow.
quests.hint: Contrast real practice with a once-a-year training session.
quests.explanation: Contrasting real practice with a forgettable annual session shows why this approach actually changes behaviour.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that helps neighbours organise a shared, rotating vegetable box from unused garden space nearby.
quests.correctAnswer: Spare garden space becomes a shared vegetable patch, and the harvest rotates fairly between everyone who helped grow it.
quests.hint: Start with the shared harvest, not just the growing.
quests.explanation: A shared harvest gives a community gardening idea a concrete, satisfying payoff everyone can picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: Real access barriers are identified room by room, giving an employer a clear, practical list instead of a vague good intention.

quests.explanation: A practical, concrete list is far more useful to an employer than a general commitment to doing better.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.correctAnswer: Feedback from an employee's own colleagues shapes a specific growth plan, so development finally targets what actually needs to change.
quests.hint: Begin with feedback shaping something specific, not generic advice.
quests.explanation: Specific, evidence-based development lands better than generic advice that could apply to almost anyone.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that helps busy adults keep in light, regular contact with old university friends despite distance.
quests.correctAnswer: A small monthly nudge keeps old university friendships genuinely alive, instead of quietly fading into an occasional 'like' on a photo.
quests.hint: Contrast real contact with a passive social-media like.
quests.explanation: Contrasting real contact with a passive like names exactly why so many good friendships quietly drift apart.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workforce analytics platform connecting hiring and team decisions directly to a company's financial performance.
quests.correctAnswer: It shows, in plain numbers, exactly how a hiring decision or a team restructure moves the company's actual bottom line.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the financial outcome, not the workforce data itself.
quests.explanation: Connecting a decision directly to the bottom line is what turns a workforce report into a genuine boardroom priority.
